content: Wogan Digettida Zin7o
GODAY Muses hizgi yootides;
«Isra7eele naytas, ‹Tani GODAA intte Xoossaa;
kase intte heen de7ida Gibxe biitta asay woykko buro ta inttena gelththana Kanaane biittan diza dere asay ooththiza shaattiza ooso intte ooththoftenne istta hano kaallofte.
Ta wogata naagite; ta azazotakka polite; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
Ta azazotanne wogata naagite; hessantta naagiza asi ba shemppo ashshana; tani GODAA› ga yoota.
«Inttefe oonikka baas asho dabbora laymatoppo; tani GODAA.
«Ne aayeyra laymatada ne aawa kawushshofa; nees aayo gidida gishshas izira laymatoppa.
«Ne aawaas hara machchetarakka laymatada ne aawa yeellachchofa.
«Ne michcheyra laymatoppa; hessaththoka nenara issife diccidaaro gidiin woykko harason diccidaaro gidiin ne aaway yelida hara machchi naa woykko ne aaya hara azinas yelida macca nayra laymatoppa.
«Nees yeella gidontta mala nees naaza nayra, woykko nees nay nayra laymatoppa.
«Ne aawaas hara machcha yelida ne michcheyra zin7ofa; gaasoykka iza nees michcho.
«Ne aawa michcheyra zin7ofa; gaasoykka iza nees michcho.
Ne aayey michcheyrakka zin7ofa; gaasoykka iza ne aayeys asho dabbo.
«Ne aawa isha machchira zin7ofa; gaasoykka iza nees aawa machchi mala.
«Ne naaza machcheyra zin7ofa; iza nees naaza machcho gidida gishshas izira zin7ofa.
Ne isha machcheyra zin7ofa; gaasoykka iza nees isha machcho; hessi ne isha kawushshiza miishsha.
«Aayeyranne nayra zin7ofa; izis nay naaza nayranne nays nay nayra zin7ofa; isttika izas mata dabbo gidida gishshas hessaththo hanoy kawushshateththa.
«Ne machchiya paxa dishin izi michchiyo dawuth ekkofa; izirakka laymatoppa.
«Aginan aginan beettiza maccassa wogay yiza wode maccassara zin7ofa.
«Hara asa machchira zin7ada nerkka nena tunisoppa.
«Ne naytappe oonakka molooke geetettiza eeqas xuugettiza yarsho ooththa immofa; gaasoykka ne Xoossaa sunth tunisoppa; tani GODAA.
«GODAA sinththan ixettida miish gidida gishshas maccassara zin7iza mala addera zin7ofa.
«Adde gidiin woykko maccassi mehera parattidi banateththaa tunisoppo; hessa mala hanoy kawushshateththa.
«GODAY nena istta dere gelththanaas ne sinththafe diggana; hankko asay barkka ba ooson bana tunisidayssa mala istti ooththiza iita oosotappe issineynka inttena tunisopite.
Istta oosoy biitta tunisida gishshas tani he biittayo izi nagara gishshas qaxxayadis; biittayakka ba giddon diza asaa kessa cuttadus.
Intte gidikko ta azazotanne ta woga naagite; Isra7eele asaappe woykko intte giddon diza hara biitta asappe oonikka hayssa mala ay oosokka ooththofte.
Inttefe kase he biittayn diza asati heyta mala harassiza miish ooththida gishshas biittaya tunadus.
Intte hessaththo ooththiko biittaya kase inttefe sinththan diza kawoteththata cuttidayssaththo inttenakka cuttana.
«Hayta harassiza iita oosotappe issineyokka ooththizaadey ba dere asaa giddofe shaaketti dhayo.
Hessa gishshas inttefe kase sinththan biitta bolla diza asati ooththida tuna oosota ubbaa ooththidi intte tunontta mala ta azazota naagite; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.»
